title: HtmlInputNumber
responsibility: Renders the native input control with type number without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlInputNumber.children
inputs.description: Optional Svelte Snippet that the component removes from the props, so it is never forwarded to the input as an attribute. The template never renders it, so passing it never changes the output.

outputs.name: HtmlInputNumber
outputs.description: The native input element that the component renders, with no wrapper element: every prop except children is spread onto it as an attribute, then type is set to 'number' after the spread, which overrides any type passed in. Its body is whitespace only, so it renders no child content.
